subject: military / physics
user: Can you explain in 3D how Iron Dome intercepts rockets?
brief: 3D model. How Iron Dome intercepts a rocket: radar detects the launch, the control center predicts where it will land, a launcher fires a Tamir interceptor that steers to the rocket and detonates next to it. Show the whole engagement over a landscape.

subject: machines
user: Show me in 3D how a jet engine works.
brief: 3D model of a turbofan engine. Cut it open: fan, compressor stages, combustor, turbine, exhaust; show airflow through it and the spinning parts.

subject: machines
user: How does the F-35 hover? Show me in 3D.
brief: 3D model. How the F-35B hovers: lift fan behind the cockpit blows air down, the rear nozzle swivels down, roll posts in the wings balance it.

subject: electronics (follow-up)
user: What is this board? Show it in 3D.
brief: 3D model of a Raspberry Pi 5 board: CPU, RAM, USB and Ethernet ports, GPIO header, camera connectors.

followup.user: How do I connect a camera module to it?
followup.brief: Follow-up on the Raspberry Pi model already on screen (id from before): add a camera module next to it and animate connecting its ribbon cable to the camera connector. Don't rebuild the board.

subject: biology
user: How does the heart pump blood? 3D please.
brief: 3D model of the human heart: four chambers, valves, blood flow from body to lungs and back out. Open it up to show the chambers.

subject: biology
user: Show me a plant cell in 3D.
brief: 3D model of a plant cell cut open: cell wall, membrane, nucleus, chloroplasts, mitochondria, large vacuole.

subject: biology / chemistry
user: What does DNA look like in 3D?
brief: 3D model of a DNA double helix: sugar-phosphate backbones, base pairs (A-T, C-G), how it unzips to copy itself.

subject: astronomy
user: Why do we have seasons? Show me in 3D.
brief: 3D model: Earth orbiting the Sun with its tilted axis; show how the tilt makes summer and winter in each hemisphere at opposite points of the orbit.

subject: machines
user: How does a car engine work? Show it in 3D.
brief: 3D model of a 4-stroke piston engine cylinder: piston, connecting rod, crankshaft, valves, spark plug; animate intake, compression, power, exhaust.

subject: chemistry
user: Why is water a bent molecule? Show me in 3D.
brief: 3D model of a water molecule: oxygen, two hydrogens, the 104.5 degree angle, the two lone pairs pushing the bonds together.

subject: math
user: What does z = x^2 - y^2 look like in 3D?
brief: 3D model of the surface z = x^2 - y^2 (a saddle): axes, the surface, the curve along x going up and along y going down, the saddle point at the origin.

subject: scale / size
user: How big is the biggest cruise ship compared to the Eiffel Tower? 3D.
brief: 3D size comparison: Icon of the Seas (365 m long, ~65 m tall) next to the Eiffel Tower (330 m tall) and a person for scale, with measurements.

subject: everyday mechanisms
user: How does a key open a lock? Show me in 3D.
brief: 3D model of a pin tumbler lock cut open: cylinder plug, key pins and driver pins with springs, shear line; the key lifts the pins to the shear line so the plug turns.

subject: earth science
brief: 3D model of a volcano cut in half: magma chamber, conduit, vent, crater, layers of ash and lava; show magma rising and erupting.
